podcast.body: Recorded on January 26, 1967, during a period when Bowie was struggling and desperate for any commercial breakthrough, this novelty song featuring cartoonish gnome voices was released as a single on April 14, 1967, and flopped entirely. After Bowie became a global star, old labels kept reissuing it. A 1973 reissue became a major UK hit — to Bowie's horror and enduring embarrassment. "An embarrassment for all time. Nice little skeleton in David Bowie's closet."
